text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Real metals let the threads smudge, like spreading ink. The smudging speed is set by the metal's magnetic diffusivity. Same flow, two metals. A good conductor smudges slowly: the threads stay sharp. A poor one smudges fast: the threads blur away.
